Name: Standard ID TRE
Description: The Standard ID TRE (STDIDC) contains image identification data that supplements the Image Subheader. Some parameters may be used by United States Imagery and Geospatial Information Service compliant systems.

ACQUISITION_DATE.Name: Acquisition Date
ACQUISITION_DATE.Description: This field contains the date of the collection mission (date of aircraft takeoff) in the format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS, in which YYYY is the year, MM is the month (01 to 12), DD is the day of the month (01 to 31), HH is the hour (00 to 23), MM is the minute (00 to 59), and SS is the second (00 to 59).  The date changes at midnight UTC.  This field is equivalent to the IDATIM field in the image subheader.

MISSION.Name: Mission Name
MISSION.Description: This field contains a fourteen character descriptor of the vehicle. For satellite, it identifies the specific vehicle as source of image data. For aerial, it identifies the scanner. See "FieldRegistry" STDIDC MISSION per paragraph 3.2 of Main Body of STDI-0002.

PASS.Name: Pass Number
PASS.Description: This field contains a number that identifies each pass or flight per day. See "FieldRegistry" STDIDC MISSION per paragraph 3.2 of Main Body of STDI-0002.

OP_NUM.Name: Image Operation Number
OP_NUM.Description: This field indicates whether the data was reprocessed to overcome initial processing failures, or has been enhanced.

START_SEGMENT.Name: Start Segment ID
START_SEGMENT.Description: This identifies images as separate pieces (segments) within an imaging operation.  AA is first segment; AB is second segment, etc.

REPRO_NUM.Name: Reprocess Number
REPRO_NUM.Description: This field indicates whether the data was reprocessed to overcome initial processing failures, or has been enhanced. A '00' indicates that the data is an originally processed image, '01' indicates the first reprocess/enhancement, etc.

REPLAY_REGEN.Name: Replay Regen
REPLAY_REGEN.Description: The Replay (remapping) imagery mode provides the capability to alter the digital processing of previously recorded digital imagery. Regen (regeneration) imagery mode provides the capability to produce an image identical to the image that was produced in initial process. The images are used as replacements for images damaged during production. A '000' in this field indicates that the data is an originally processed image.

BLANK_FILL.Name: Blank Fill
BLANK_FILL.Description: This field is blank and will be empty or contain an underscore.

START_COLUMN.Name: Starting Column Block
START_COLUMN.Description: This field, for tiled (blocked) sub-images, has the starting column block defined as the offset, in blocks, of the first block in the cross-scan direction relative to start of the original reference image tiling.

START_ROW.Name: Starting Row Block
START_ROW.Description: This field, for tiled (blocked) sub-images, has the starting row block defined as the offset, in blocks, of the first block in the along-scan direction relative to start of the original reference image tiling.

END_SEGMENT.Name: Ending Segment ID
END_SEGMENT.Description: This field contains the ending segment ID of this file. AA to ZZ.

END_COLUMN.Name: Ending Column Block
END_COLUMN.Description: This field, for tiled (blocked) sub-images, has the ending column block defined as the offset, in blocks, of the last block of the image in the cross-scan direction relative to start of the original reference image tiling.

END_ROW.Name: Ending Row Block
END_ROW.Description: This field, for tiled (blocked) sub-images, has the ending row block defined as the offset, in blocks, of the last block in the along-scan direction relative to start of the original reference image tiling.

COUNTRY.Name: Country Code
COUNTRY.Description: This field contains a two letter code defining the country for the reference point of the image. Standard codes may be found in FIPS PUB 10-4.

WAC.Name: World Aeronautical Chart
WAC.Description: This is a four number World Aeronautical Chart for the reference point of the image segment. WAC grids the earth into regions with a 4 number ID.

LOCATION.Name: Location Reference
LOCATION.Description: This is the natural reference point of the sensor; a rough indication of geographic coverage. The format DDMMX represents degrees (00 to 89) and minutes (00 to 59) of latitude, with X = N or S for north or south, and DDMMY represents degrees (000 to 179) and minutes (00 to 59) of longitude, with Y = E or W for east or west, respectively. For SAR imagery, the reference point is normally the center of the first image block. For EO-IR imagery, the reference point for framing sensors is the center of the frame; for continuous sensors, it is the center of the first line.

RESERV01.Name: Reserved 1
RESERV01.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.

RESERV02.Name: Reserved 2
RESERV02.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.
